description: Work out the totals for a UK invoice or full VAT invoice from its line items, in whole pence. Each line has a quantity, a unit price before VAT and, when vatRegistered is true, a VAT rate of 20, 5, 0, exempt or outside (the scope of VAT). VAT is rounded to the nearest penny on each line and summed per rate, as HMRC VAT Notice 700 allows. Returns line, per-rate and invoice totals, the total VAT in sterling for a foreign-currency VAT invoice (needs exchangeRate), the due date from termsDays, whether a simplified VAT invoice is allowed, the late payment compensation band and a list of missing details. Totals only: the printable invoice and PDF are made on the page, and descriptions are never echoed back. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/invoice-generator/

detailsIncluded.description: Which other details the invoice will show, to list anything missing. Leave a key out if unknown

sellerContact.description: An email address or phone number

exchangeRate.description: How much of the currency £1 buys, such as 1.17 for euros. Needed for a VAT invoice not in GBP, so the total VAT can be shown in sterling

lineItems.description: The lines on the invoice, up to 200

description.description: What the line is for. Only checked for being present, never returned

quantity.description: How many, above 0, up to 3 decimal places. A number, or text such as '1,000'

unitPrice.description: Price of one unit before VAT, up to 2 decimal places. Negative for a discount line. A number, or text such as '£1,234.50'

vatRate.description: VAT rate for the line when vatRegistered is true: 20, 5, 0 (zero-rated), exempt or outside the scope. Ignored otherwise

supplyDate.description: Date the goods or services were supplied (the tax point), YYYY-MM-DD

termsDays.description: Days the customer has to pay; 0 means on receipt

vatRegistered.description: True for a full VAT invoice with VAT on each line; false for a plain invoice with no VAT
